sloka: न च मे भविता तत्र कश्चित् पथि परिश्रमः ।पृष्ठतः तव गच्चन्त्या विहार शयनेष्व् अपि ॥२-३०-११॥
transliteration: na ca me bhavitā tatra kaścit pathi pariśramaḥ ।pṛṣṭhataḥ tava gaccantyā vihāra śayaneṣv api ॥2-30-11॥

translations.english: While following you, I will feel no fatigue there on the way as if I am going on a pleasurestroll or in a comfortable couch.
